alt: Three Markdown docs from markdown_files/ become Document nodes in Neo4j, each joined by a MENTION edge to the shared CocoIndex entity; LLM-extracted triples become RELATIONSHIP edges such as CocoIndex supports Incremental Processing, Incremental Processing relies on change detection, and triple becomes relationship; editing incremental_processing.md re-derives only its Document node and MENTION edge, and the Cypher query "How concepts relate" lists those triples.

run.note: Explore it in Neo4j Browser (neo4j / cocoindex)
